blocks.tamil_translation: ?’ When the people asked, “Where is the inheritance of Rasulullah ﷺ being distributed?’ he replied, “It is being distributed in the masjid.’ The people hurried to the masjid, and Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) remained there waiting for the people to return; meanwhile the people came back’, Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) asked the people, “Why have you come back?” They said, “We went to the masjid and looked; nothing was being distributed there.’ When Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) asked, “Did you not see anyone in the masjid?’ they said, “We saw some praying, some reciting the Qur'an, and some discussing what is halal and haram.’ Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) explained, “I pity you! This is the inheritance of Rasulullah ﷺ.’

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ يَعْنِي ابْنَ مَسْعُود ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: إِذَا أَرَادَ اللهُ بِعَبْدٍ خَيْرًا فَقَّهَهُ فِي الدِّينِ وَاَلْهَمَهُ رُشْدَهُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البزار والطبرانى فى الكبير ورجاله موثقون مجمع الزوائد:١٢١٢٠/١
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abdullah ibn Mas'ud (RA) has narrated that the Prophet ﷺ said, “When Allah intends good for anyone, He causes understanding of the Deen (and good thoughts) to arise in his heart.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي وَاقِدِنِ اللَّيْثِيِّ ﵁ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ بَيْنَمَا هُوَ جَالِسٌ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ وَالنَّاسُ مَعَهُ إِذْ أَقْبَلَ ثَلَاثَةُ نَفَرٍ فَأَقْبَلَ اثْنَانِ إِليَ رَسُولِ اللهِ ﷺ وَذَهَبَ وَاحِدٌ قَالَ فَوَقَفَا عَلَي رَسُولِ اللهِ ﷺ فَأَمَّا أَحَدُهُمَا فَرَأَي فُرْجَةً فَي الْحَلْقَةِ فَجَلَسَ فِيهَا وَأَمَّا اْلآخَرُ فَجَلَسَ خَلْفَهُمْ وَأَمَّا
